en: Black-and-white postcard showing the richly decorated interior altar of a chapel behind an iron grille. The altar is adorned with flowers, candles, and an ornate framed figure or statue, likely of the Virgin Mary, set within baroque-style architectural carvings. At the bottom margin, there is a caption in German with a serial number identifying the place as a chapel in a church in Graz.
